source_refs.excerpt: The Service Provider acknowledges that all information which it receives from the Bank in the course or in connection with the provision of the Services and all information which the Service Provider develops as part of the Services is to be considered as confidential in nature for the purposes of this Agreement including the identity of the parties and the fact that the parties are in contact with each other (collectively "Confidential Information"). source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Describe the practitioner talent your firm can draw on, internally or externally. Rather than listing names or submitting bios for all potential resources, tell us about your bench/roster: the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how you ensure quality and consistency when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.
